Jules (Customer): hitting 400 on /v1/rerank - saying \"Malformed request JSON\" but payload looks fine on our side. Can someone take a look?
Ivy (Support): sorry you're blocked, can you paste the exact request body and the API response? also which model/route are you calling?
Jules (Customer): sending now. endpoint: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
```
curl -X POST \ 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" \ 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \ 
  -d '{
    "query": "Which paper should I read first on transformers?",
    "candidate_ids": ["a1", "b2", "c3"],
    "topk": "5"
  }' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
```
Response: 400 {"error":"Malformed request JSON: expected 'candidates' array of objects with 'id' and 'text' fields"}
Ivy (Support): thanks. couple of quick notes: we expect a `candidates` array (objects), not `candidate_ids`, and `top_k` should be an integer. `topk` as a string could trigger schema validation. tagging eng. @Mike @Sara
Mike (Backend): on it. can you also share the full raw body (no shell interpolation) and the content-length? sometimes client libs stringify numbers.
Jules (Customer): full raw body below (from our app logs):
```
{"query":"Which paper should I read first on transformers?","candidate_ids":["a1","b2","c3"],"topk":"5"}
```
OpsBot: incoming validation failure event: request_id=req_9f3a, route=/v1/rerank, schema_err=MissingProperty(candidates), type_mismatch(top_k expected integer)
Sara (Eng Runtime): quick diagnosis: two issues show up here -> 1) wrong field name `candidate_ids` instead of `candidates` (we require objects so we have both id and context), 2) `topk` string vs `top_k` integer. Our validator returns a generic "Malformed request JSON" which is unhelpful.
Sara (Eng Runtime): can you reproduce with minimal curl? try this corrected payload — should return 200 (or a better validation error if still wrong):
```
curl -X POST \ 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" \ 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \ 
  -d '{
    "query": "Which paper should I read first on transformers?",
    "candidates": [
      {"id": "a1", "text": "Attention is All You Need"},
      {"id": "b2", "text": "BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers"},
      {"id": "c3", "text": "GPT: Improving Language Understanding"}
    ],
    "top_k": 3
  }' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
```
Jules (Customer): sending that now... got 200, thanks! response looks good.
Ivy (Support): great — seems like the client's SDK is mapping candidate IDs to a different field and serializing numbers as strings. did you recently upgrade the SDK or change request shaping?
Jules (Customer): we did a small refactor last week, updated our DTOs. I'll roll back the change on our side.
Mike (Backend): action items: 1) support -> advise customer and close once they confirm; 2) eng-runtime -> improve error message from generic \"Malformed request JSON\" to include which fields failed validation (e.g., \"missing 'candidates'\", \"top_k must be integer\"). filing internal task.
Sara (Eng Runtime): filing ticket: RUNTIME-1284 \"Improve rerank validation errors\" — will add field-level details and examples. temporary mitigation: update docs with explicit example showing `candidates` objects and `top_k` integer.
Ivy (Support): @Jules please confirm after your deploy, and if you want we can run a quick smoke test from our side before closing. :thumbsup:
Jules (Customer): will do today, thanks for the fast triage :raised_hands:
Mike (Backend): also note: we saw some requests where `candidates` was an empty array (no objects). we should return 400 with message \"candidates must be non-empty array of objects\" instead of generic. adding to RUNTIME-1284.
Sara (Eng Runtime): agreed. I'll add unit tests to catch string-int coercion and wrong-key payloads so future SDK changes are caught by integration tests.
Ivy (Support): marking this as escalated -> resolved once customer confirms. documented repro + recommended corrected payload in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
Jules (Customer): confirmed fixed after rollback. thanks everyone! :heart:
